field_notes.total_raised: Monetary contributions as summarized by the Bay County SOE campaign-finance system (includes candidate loans and self-contributions; excludes in-kind).
field_notes.in_kind: In-kind contributions as summarized by the SOE.
field_notes.total_spent: SOE "Total Expenditures & Distributions". For closed campaigns this includes distributions of surplus funds (e.g. returned to contributors, donated to charity or party, or moved to an office account), so it often equals the amount raised.
field_notes.loans: Sum of items the filer coded as loans (all loans found were from the candidate).
field_notes.n_contributions: Count of positive contribution items (check, cash, in-kind, loan) after amendments/deletions; excludes refunds and bank interest.
field_notes.from_individuals: Count and net total of contributions from individual people (monetary and in-kind, net of any refunds). Names are not stored.
field_notes.contributors: Organization contributions listed item by item (businesses, PACs/committees, other campaigns, other organizations), plus one aggregate line for the candidate's own money. Negative amounts are refunds the campaign reported. City is as written in the filing. Contributor type follows the filer's code, corrected where the name plainly showed an organization or a person.

gaps: Corey Langford (Lynn Haven commissioner): no campaign account found in the Bay County SOE system for any election from 2022 through the 2027 municipal cycle. Recorded votes show Judy Tinder voting as a commissioner through Sep 2026, so he may have been appointed; not verified.

Mark Rega (Parker council member): no campaign account found in the Bay County SOE system for 2022-2027 elections. Parker Seat 4 was won by Stacie Galbreath in 2023, so he may have been appointed; not verified.
Mexico Beach Group 4 is listed as vacant in the officials list and was not included (SOE shows Carrie Ruscoe elected to Group 4 in Apr 2026: $100 monetary, $25 in-kind).
School Board District 2: Ginger Littleton (2026 winner, term begins Nov 2026) is not yet the officeholder and was not included; SOE shows $22,360 monetary and $500 in-kind as of the latest report.
School Board Districts 1, 3, 4 and 5 (Jerry L. Register, Christopher Moore, Winston Chester, Steve Moss) are missing from the officials list and were added from the Supervisor of Elections.
Races still in progress (Christopher Moore, Mary Coburn, Bobby J. Birdsell) reflect only reports filed as of 2026-10-21.

Contract data covers Bay County BOCC and the seven cities FY2023-FY2026. It does not cover Bay District Schools or the constitutional officers' own purchasing, so contributor matches for school board and constitutional-officer campaigns are matched only against county/city vendors. Lynn Haven check-register vendor names are truncated at 15 characters in the source.
Contributors filed as individuals who own businesses, and contributions from company owners or employees, are not matched to vendors (individuals are not named in this dataset).

Possible matches left out as unclear: "Halls Contracting" (Ford) vs vendor "Hall Contracting & Construction, Inc."; "ESCS LLC" (Ford) vs "ECSC, LLC"; "RJ Gorman Construction" (Ford), which could be RJ Gorman Marine Construction, LLC or RJ Gorman Contracting, LLC; "Emerald Coast Civil Constructi" (Crosby) vs "Emerald Coast Site Construction".
